slug: 2025-10-01 BCEAO Launches Instant Payments Platform in Togo with Three Banks

facts.fact: Togo First reports BCEAO launched the interoperable instant payments platform on 30 September 2025 for 24/7 transfers across the eight UEMOA countries, including Togo, with Coris Bank, Ecobank and Orabank operating on it in Togo.

systems.tiers: banks, microfinance institutions, e-money issuers, payment service providers
